title: 1st Source Bank Foundation Donates $100,000 to Disaster Recovery
summary: 1st Source Bank Foundation is donating $100,000 to seven Northwest Indiana organizations for storm recovery in LaPorte and Porter counties.
body_markdown:
## ***Donation to Seven Northwest Indiana Organizations in Response to Severe August Storms***


*South Bend, Ind. (September 3, 2026)* – 1st Source Bank Foundation announced that it will donate $100,000 to support disaster recovery efforts in response to the recent severe storms in LaPorte and Porter Counties in Indiana. The donation will be split between seven community organizations in northwest Indiana including The Food Bank of Northwest Indiana, Porter County Community Foundation, The Salvation Army of Porter County, The Salvation Army of LaPorte County, United Way of LaPorte County, United Way of Northwest Indiana, and Unity Foundation of LaPorte County.


These grants will help provide immediate assistance and long-term recovery support to residents, families and communities affected by the storms, which caused significant damage throughout the region.


“The devastation caused by these storms has impacted many families and businesses across northwest Indiana,” said Andrea Short, Vice President of 1st Source Bank Foundation and CEO of 1st Source Bank. “As a community-focused organization, 1st Source Bank Foundation is committed to supporting our neighbors during times of need. By partnering with these trusted, local organizations, we can help ensure critical resources reach those who were affected and assist our communities as they recover and rebuild.”


Representatives from the recipient organizations expressed gratitude for 1st Source Bank Foundation’s support and noted that the donations will help provide critical assistance to affected residents while reinforcing a collaborative recovery effort focused on rebuilding stronger, more resilient communities.


“Recovering from this scale of a natural disaster requires the partnership of many organizations working together,” Short said. “We are grateful for the work these organizations do in our communities every day, and especially in times of crisis. Their local expertise and community relationships make them uniquely positioned to help those who need it most.”


1st Source Bank Foundation is committed to improving the quality of life for those in the community who live, work, raise families, and build businesses in 1st Source Bank’s footprint.


---


*1st Source Bank Foundation works in collaboration with 1st Source Bank to enhance and strengthen the social, economic, and cultural fabric of our communities through a commitment of providing financial resources. 1st Source Bank Foundation provides support to organizations working in the following areas: Social welfare and human services, education, arts and culture and economic development.*


** *1st Source Corporation (NASDAQ: SRCE), parent company of 1st Source Bank, has assets of $9.3 billion and is the largest locally controlled financial institution headquartered in the northern Indiana-southwestern Michigan area. The Corporation includes 78 banking centers, 15 1st Source Bank Specialty Finance Group locations nationwide, nine Trust and Wealth Advisory Services locations, 13 1st Source Insurance offices, and three loan production offices. For more than 160 years, 1st Source has been committed to our mission of Helping Our Clients Achieve Security, Build Wealth And Realize Their Dreams®.*
